_what: LAYER 1 — facts about Higgsfield itself, true whatever you are filming. This is the ONLY layer that expires. Re-verify against the live catalogue; do not trust age.
_verified_how: models_explore action=get on EVERY id listed below, one call each, on the date above. Read-only, no credits. The first version of this file claimed the same thing while only two of the nine had actually been fetched by id — the rest were copied out of a search listing. A false provenance claim in the file whose entire purpose is provenance is worse than none, so each model now carries how it was checked.
_why_expiry: The origin project's shot script carried the line 'thirteen seconds is not a length the model offers' for days after it stopped being true. Nothing made it expire, so nothing made anybody look. A layer whose facts come from someone else's API needs a date on it or it becomes folklore.
_near_miss_worth_keeping: A semantic search for 'nano banana pro' returned FLUX.2 and Seedream 5.0 Pro and NOT the model itself, and the first conclusion drawn was that it had been retired — which would have been written in here as a fact. `action=get model_id=nano_banana_pro` returns it, alive. ABSENCE FROM A SEARCH IS NOT ABSENCE FROM THE CATALOGUE. Confirm a model is gone by asking for it by id, never by failing to find it.

resolution.constraint: 4k and 1080p require mode='std'. mode='fast' supports 480p and 720p ONLY.

generate_audio.WATCH: DEFAULT IS TRUE. A film that scores and mixes its own audio must pass generate_audio=false explicitly, or every clip arrives carrying native audio nobody asked for. Independent of audio_references.

seedance_2_0_mini.name: Seedance 2.0 Mini
seedance_2_0_mini.note: Same duration range and the same five media roles as the full model, at 480p/720p. A cheaper way to test blocking and timing before spending on a 720p std draft.

minimax_h3.name: MiniMax H3
minimax_h3.note: Recorded only because it also takes start and end frames. Not evaluated for this method.

folder_id.note: places the output in a folder; no other model here has it

nano_banana_pro.name: Nano Banana Pro
nano_banana_pro.note: One role, `image`, used for both text-to-image (omit it) and image-to-image (pass a job id or media id). 4k is available; the origin project's notes record only 1k and 2k.

quality.note: basic renders up to 4K, high up to ~6K

seedream_v5_pro.name: Seedream 5.0 Pro
seedream_v5_pro.note: Instruction-based editing and visual reasoning. Worth testing against nano_banana_pro for derived-angle edits — that is a capability comparison nobody has run.

capability_limits.elements_are_global: An element conditions EVERY frame of a generation, not a span of it. Two states of one room cannot both be attached; the second appears in frame 1 and destroys the reveal.
capability_limits.an_element_carries_a_composition: A location element supplies the AXIS its own plate was shot on, not just its materials. Ask for a camera rotated off that axis and the model drops either the room or the subject.
capability_limits.no_novel_view_synthesis: These models do not rotate a scene. Image-to-image is an in-place edit engine: it will change what is in a frame and it will not re-photograph that frame from somewhere else. A new angle must be re-photographed by prose, or the shot must change.
capability_limits.a_prohibition_summons: A negation is a description with a minus sign in front, and the minus sign is the least reliable token in it. Enumerate what a surface DOES carry, and close the list.
capability_limits._where_these_came_from: Measured on the origin project across dozens of generations, not read from documentation. They are capability claims rather than API facts, so they do not expire on the same clock — but they are model behaviour, and model behaviour changes when a model does.

not_verified.credit_rates: models_explore does not expose pricing. The origin project's measured rates are in ITS facts file and are as old as the day they were measured. Re-derive from `transactions` after a real generation; never quote a price out of a project's notes as though it were an API fact.
not_verified.unlim_allowance: `unlim.available` read FALSE on 2026-08-01 for this account. That is an account state, not a model fact, and it changes.
not_verified.whether_all_five_media_roles_work_togeth: Five roles are declared on Seedance. Nobody has tested passing all five in one call.
not_verified.the_genre_and_bitrate_parameters: `genre` and `bitrate_mode` exist and the origin project has never used either. Unknown whether genre helps or fights a carefully written prompt.

_expires_after_days_is_a_guess: 45 is not derived from anything. Nobody has measured how often this catalogue changes. Replace it with an observed rate once there are two dated versions of this file to compare, and until then treat it as a reminder rather than a finding.
_unlim_is_not_universal: supports_unlim is TRUE for seedance_2_0, seedance_2_0_mini, nano_banana_pro, gpt_image_2, seedream_v4_5 and seedream_v5_pro, and ABSENT for minimax_h3, flux_kontext and openai_hazel. Absent is recorded as false here rather than left out, because a missing key and a false value read the same to a person skimming and differently to anything that checks.
